source_contract.event_reference: preserve each normalized event_id and support_ref without replacement

process_precedence: ocsf.unmapped paired /Event/EventData/Data/@Name and /Event/EventData/Data/#text where the name is CommandLine
ocsf.unmapped columns.cmdline, columns.command_line, cmdline, command_line, or CommandLine
event_log_precedence: ocsf.unmapped ScriptBlockText, script_block, script, or body
ocsf.unmapped paired EventData arrays where the name is ScriptBlockText
ocsf.message only when normalized event_id is 4104
api: service, resource, and status when present

powershell_encoded_command.failure_policy: retain the admitted command and omit decoded_script

bounds.source_reading: receipt-admitted Parquet row groups with bounded worker waves
bounds.output_grouping: bounded sorted document runs and fixed-size occurrence shards

known_source_limit.powershell_4104: Only fields present in the admitted M45 typed row are projected. A script body absent from M45 cannot be restored. A retained message header is labelled powershell_4104_message and is not described as a full script body.
